Leah CS: Quick note: SolisCare sent a 40-question vendor risk form and flagged 'data residency' and 'retention for embeddings' as blockers for renewal. They want a single-sheet summary for execs.
Tom AE: Execs only want the one-pager. We can keep detailed answers in the ticket. Can CS produce a one-pager with binary answers (Yes/No) + short caveats?
Arman - Security: Yes, we can. High-level: Hosted supports region-specific storage per tenant, but cold-tier may be cross-region unless explicit region-lock requested. Encryption at rest is AES-256, KMS-managed.
Keiko Legal: Solis asked for a DPA amendment to include an embeddings retention clause. That might require a legal review.
ops-bot: New ticket created CS-2050 assigned to Leah CS.
Leah CS: I'll draft the one-pager. Need a confirmation on deletion SLA: is it 30 days for Hosted by default?
Arman - Security: Deletion workflow: async deletion job runs; data marked for deletion then background job purges within 30 days; audit logs created. We'll provide sample log lines.
Tom AE: Also want migration options if they require BYOK or strict regional cold storage. Include cost/time ballpark.
Keiko Legal: Flagging: if they demand contract-level SLA changes, we should loop Solutions and Sales.
Leah CS: Plan: I'll prepare one-pager with columns: Question | Answer | Caveat. Draft by noon tomorrow and upload to CS-2050.
Tom AE: I'll coordinate with execs on preferred delivery.
Arman - Security: Uploading proof snippets now.
Leah CS: Uploaded draft one-pager. Please quick review.
Keiko Legal: Reviewed and added a short paragraph re: DPA amendment process.
ops-bot: Reminder: review meeting scheduled 2024-05-10 15:00 PT.
Leah CS: Thanks everyone. We'll finalize after the review and send the packet.
Tom AE: Thanks team. Execs appreciate the concise summary.

Leah CS: closing loop here.
